purpose: Briefs for evaluating an agent using the skill. These are not records of completed agent runs.

cases.prompt: Make a six-second square launch title in the active design system. The supplied copy is Make room for ideas, followed by Start with one idea. Use kinetic type. Deliver a WebM and editable source. Keep it silent.
checks: Final copy has a reading hold
Review includes both sides of the text change

cases.prompt: Make an eight-second landscape demonstration of this example workflow: choose a layout, then preview the result. Show a simple invented interface labelled Example workspace. Use the active design system. Do not invent product claims or metrics.
checks: Selection indicator follows the explained step

cases.prompt: Make a ten-second square, silent explainer. Show Give each idea time to be understood. for five seconds, then A clear message can stay still. for five seconds. Keep both passages still while they are read.
checks: No camera drift, text loop or decorative motion during holds
Intentional holds are not reported as export failures

cases.prompt: Adapt the quiet explainer into three separate language variants using this supplied first passage: Дайте каждой идее время. / امنح كل فكرة وقتها. / Geben Sie jedem Gedanken genügend Zeit, damit er verstanden werden kann. Keep the source editable, preserve the script's shaping and check each layout before delivery.
checks: No missing-glyph claim based only on schema validation
Long German copy fits or receives an explicit layout adjustment
No claim of review for an unrendered variant

cases.prompt: Using the audio file supplied with this evaluation, make a twelve-second landscape product demonstration. Keep this soundtrack, place the reveal at its four-second cue and leave the final message readable for three seconds. Package the editable source with its media.
requires: Evaluator supplies a reusable twelve-second audio fixture with a known cue at four seconds
checks: Picture and sound cue remain aligned after a timing edit
Unsupported cue binding is disclosed rather than invented

reviewed: Sound supports the message when requested
rubric.report: Record artifacts, measurements, findings, unavailable capabilities and unresolved issues. Passing artifact checks does not establish creative quality.
